description: kinSoftChallenge kinetic-rate validation reference (PRD §8 NFR-VALID(c), §9 M8). Ground-truth kinetic models and the reported inter-tool spread of the blind benchmark, plus Tether's own measured deviation. The oracle checks that Tether's fitted rates on a level fall within that dataset's reported inter-tool spread — an ADVISORY check (never gates main).

source.citation: Götz M, Barth A, Bohr SS-R, et al. A blind benchmark of analysis tools to infer kinetic rate constants from single-molecule FRET trajectories. Nature Communications 13:5402 (2022).
source.ground_truth_source: Supplementary Table 5 (simulation parameters, kinetic-model diagrams) and Supplementary Table 1 (Fig. 4 ground-truth rate matrix) of the Supplementary Information; rate constants in s^-1.
source.spread_source: Main text: 2-state (Fig. 2) inferred rate constants across the 14 analyses deviate at most 12% from ground truth (5% average); FRET efficiencies within 17% (1% average). Finite-dataset MLE uncertainty floor is >=3% (1 sigma). The 3-state (Fig. 3) best tools reach 9-14% average deviation; the 4-state (Fig. 4) case is compared via cumulative dwell-time distributions, not direct rates.

band.rationale: The reported inter-tool spread for the archetypal 2-state simulated dataset: the 14 benchmark analyses inferred rate constants within a maximum of 12% of ground truth (5% average), above a >=3% (1 sigma) finite-dataset floor. Used as the advisory acceptance band on |k - GT|/GT per rate constant. Tether's own base-env fit lands at 2.3%/3.1% (see levels.level1.tether_measured), ~4x inside the band.

tether_measured.method: base-env 2-state Gaussian HMM (Baum-Welch + Viterbi) + pooled dwell-time MLE (k = 1/<tau>)
tether_measured.note: Measured on the committed kinsoft_sim.hdf5 level1 (75 traces); both rates ~4x inside the 12% band. See tests/test_kinsoft_kinetics.py.

level2.report_reason: Fitted and reported, never band-checked (#717, ADR-0082). A 3-state fit of the base-env HMM finds the three FRET levels, but a 1<->3 jump inside one 0.1 s frame averages to a mid-FRET frame, which Viterbi reads as a 1-frame dwell in state 2. So the six rates are biased: k21 and k32 up, k13 and k31 down. The method has no correction for a transition inside a frame.

ground_truth.note: The full rate matrix of the simulator settings file (rows: from, columns: to; the file's state numbers). tests/test_kinsoft_levels.py requires every value here, the state count, the frame time and the trace count to equal what tests/_kinsoft_config.py reads from the file, and the FRET values are Ida/(Idd+Ida) of its mean intensities. The entry before #717 read k12_low_mid 0.05 and k21_mid_low 0.30 from the Suppl. Table 5 diagram; the settings file gives the reverse, and Tether's fit agrees with the file on the faster direction of each pair.

tether_measured.method: base-env 3-state Gaussian HMM (Baum-Welch + Viterbi) + pooled transition counts k_ij = n_ij / T_i over the dwells pooled_exit_rates counts
tether_measured.note: Measured 2026-11-12 (#717) on the committed kinsoft_sim.hdf5 level2 (150 traces), Linux x86-64 with the base lock. Advisory: no rate is held to the band. 689 of the 1638 counted mid-FRET dwells last one frame, and 650 of all mid-FRET frames sit alone between a low and a high frame.

level3.system: 4-state kinetic heterogeneity (two low-FRET + two high-FRET states; donor/acceptor blinking)
level3.report_reason: Compared through cumulative dwell-time distributions, as the benchmark does, and never band-checked (#717, ADR-0082). A FRET-only 2-state fit sees the two observable levels. For each level the test compares the pooled Viterbi dwells with the dwell-time distribution that the true 4-state matrix predicts for an aggregated Markov process [Colquhoun1981, Colquhoun1982], by the Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance and by the relative error of the mean dwell.

ground_truth.note: Full 4-state ground-truth rate matrix in the state numbers of Suppl. Table 1 (all other off-diagonal rates are 0); blinking kbright=7 s^-1, kdark=0.007 s^-1. The simulator settings file numbers the same states differently, and settings_state_of maps each state here to its row there. tests/test_kinsoft_levels.py requires every rate, every zero, both blinking rates of both dyes, the state count, the frame time and the trace count to equal what tests/_kinsoft_config.py reads from the file.

tether_measured.method: base-env 2-state Gaussian HMM (Baum-Welch + Viterbi); pooled dwells of each FRET level (first and last of each molecule dropped) against the aggregated-Markov dwell-time CDF of the true matrix
tether_measured.note: Measured 2026-11-12 (#717) on the committed kinsoft_sim.hdf5 level3 (250 traces), Linux x86-64 with the base lock. Advisory: no distance is held to a band. The observed dwells are shorter than predicted. The traces are short against the dwells (median 35.7 s against a predicted mean low-FRET dwell of 9.1 s), and a dwell that a trace end cuts is never counted, so long dwells are under-sampled; blinking and noise also split dwells.
